columns.name: country_population
columns.description: The population number of the country.

columns.name: the_majority_ethnic_group
columns.description: The majority ethnic group in the country, with ties broken by the ascending order of the ethnic group name.

columns.name: num_ethnic_groups
columns.description: The number of ethnic groups in the country, replace NULL values with 0.

columns.name: num_languages_spoken
columns.description: The number of languages spoken in the country, replace NULL values with 0.

columns.name: has_over_1_organizations_and_an_inflation_rate_of_over_3_per
columns.description: Set to 1 if more than one organization is headquartered in the country and the country's inflation rate is greater than 3. Otherwise set to 0.

columns.name: num_neighbors
columns.description: The number of neighbors of the country, replace NULL values with 0.
